title: Asks for a human twice, then pays today
script: Confirms he is Daniel Reyes. Gives the date of birth and the last four digits when asked. After the agent states the late payment, asks to speak to a human. When the agent offers to help, asks for a human once more. When the agent offers to help again, says fine, he can pay the full amount today. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: the agent does not transfer after the first or the second request for a human
promise recorded for 420.00 today, exactly once
text-message sentence said after the promise
